obstruction_decel — DRIVE crossing op

• Data kinds: any → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.obstruction_decel(dist, speed, t_free, *, sudden: 'float' = 2.0) -> 'Dict[str, object]' (to call the implementation directly, import drivecrossing; drivecrossing.obstruction_decel(dist, speed, t_free, *, sudden: 'float' = 2.0) -> 'Dict[str, object]'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("obstruction_decel"))

Usage

Constant deceleration required for a vehicle on the crossing road (distance dist to the zone, speed speed) not to enter the zone before t_free (closed form, arrays allowed).

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

T = t_free。speed·T ≤ dist なら 0(減速しなくても間に合う)。T ≤ 2 dist / speed なら 2(speed·T − dist)/T²、それより後なら speed² / (2 dist)(領域の手前で止まる)。obstructs = 減速度 > sudden(仮定 2.0 m/s²、2 条 22 号「速度又は方向を急に変更しなければならない」)。dist ≤ 0(もう領域にいる)で T > 0 は ∞。
